item.title: Python development with emacs
item.description:
https://github.com/direnv/direnv/wiki/Python

lsp

Language Server Protocol is a set of protocols developed by Microsoft originally for VSCode. It provides smart IDE features for any editor like autocompletion, go to definition, documentation etc.

  (use-package lsp-mode
  :ensure t
  :defer t
  :commands (lsp lsp-deferred) ;; lsp mode gets loaded when lsp, lsp-deferred are triggered
  :config
  ;; your config here)


(use-package lsp-ui
  :ensure t
  :hook (lsp-mode . lsp-ui-mode)
  :after lsp-mode)

Direnv

Direnv is a unique piece of software that checks your current direnctory for an .envrc configuration file and if the file exists, direnv automatically loads environment variables specific to the current shell session, streamlining environment management for individual projects.
